title: Sixth Street CEO Warns of AI Race Speculation
digest:
Sixth Street Partners CEO Alan Waxman warned in a Bloomberg interview (Nov 11, 2026) that the AI race is characterized by speculative behavior, citing unprecedented capital spending without clear unit economics. The firm has accordingly adopted a cautious stance.

The warning highlights concerns over the AI sector's sustainability, where companies are scaling investments despite uncertain profitability. This reflects broader industry skepticism as 2026 marks the third consecutive year of AI-related spending surges without proven scalable business models.
